title: Personal Services Plan Terms Schedule — Eligible Residences, Start Day, Commitment and Notice Days
content:
This schedule of the Personal Services Plan terms lists, tier by tier, the Larkspur residence categories whose residents may hold the tier, whether both occupants of a double-occupancy independent living apartment draw from the one plan, the day of the month on which a plan or a package change takes effect, the minimum number of calendar months a package must remain in effect before a cancellation can take effect, and the days of the month by which a package change and a cancellation must be signed.

## Residence and household

| Tier | Residence categories whose residents may hold it | Both occupants of a double-occupancy independent living apartment draw from the one plan |
|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | Independent living, assisted living | Yes |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | Independent living, assisted living | Yes |
| Personal Services Companion Package | Independent living, assisted living | Yes |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | Independent living only | Yes |
| Personal Services Premier Package | Independent living only | Yes |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | Independent living only | Yes |

## Calendar figures

| Tier | Day of the month a plan or package change takes effect | Minimum commitment (calendar months) | Package change signed by day | Cancellation signed by day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 1 | 0 | 20 | 20 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 1 | 3 | 20 | 20 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 1 | 3 | 20 | 20 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 1 | 3 | 20 | 20 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 1 | 3 | 20 | 20 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 1 | 3 | 20 | 20 |

## Notes

- A plan or a package change always takes effect on the 1st of a month.
- The Pay-As-You-Go Plan carries no minimum commitment (0 months); each of the five packages carries 3 calendar months.
- The package change cutoff and the cancellation cutoff are both the 20th of the month on every tier.
- An assisted living resident's choice is limited to the three tiers open to assisted living: the Pay-As-You-Go Plan, the Essentials Package and the Companion Package.
